method: Each board re-fetched live by scripts/build_seed_pl.py (fetchers in scripts/ats_pl.py). ATS identified from careers-page HTML/links (scripts/detect_ats.py, detect_ats2.py) or a slug guess that passed identity checks (board/company name or job text names the company). verified=true => HTTP 200 + parseable feed + >=1 open job. pl_located_jobs_at_check = location or title matches Polish city/country regex. Leadership flags = title regex (EM/Head/Director/VP/CTO/Delivery Manager/kierownik/dyrektor) on PL-located jobs, or on remote-flagged EU/EMEA jobs. hq_or_relevant_locations is a hand-written hint (UNVERIFIED). Companies already in seed-companies.json are NOT duplicated (see already_in_seed_companies_json).
